title: I just Vibe coded this Wreckfest + Death Rally combo game in 24 days
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
22 days into vibecoding a destruction derby game. I may have gone too far.

I started Brutal Derby less than a month ago, and things escalated pretty quickly.

It now has 24 cars running full physics, vehicle deformation and destruction, bullet impacts, breakable objects, a ridiculous amount of particles, a living 3D crowd, spatial audio, weapons, and multiple tracks/arenas.

The last week was mostly a mix of adding cool stuff, breaking everything, optimizing it, then adding more cool stuff and breaking it again.

Current performance: around 60–100 FPS at 4K on an RTX 3070 in the build.

Still very much in development, but it's finally starting to feel like an actual game.

Brutal Derby is also on Steam if anyone wants to follow the development / wishlist it.
